content:
Maria: :rotating_light: EU-central (eu-ct) GPU pool reporting 3/8 nodes UNHEALTHY, remaining nodes showing elevated CPU and QPS. p95 latency jumped to ~900ms (baseline ~320ms). GSLB started auto-steer but some session-affinity flows still hitting eu. Proposing a surgical redispatch: reduce eu weight to 10% and push ~90% to na-west for 10m. Thoughts?

Jon: Prefer TTL=20 and a canary first (5-10%) to validate cache warmup. If warmups fail, escalate to the 90% plan.

Lee: Cost note — cross-region token egress estimated +22% for that window if we push 90% to NA. Also watch customer tags: eu_pii customers can't be moved without consent.

Priya: Oncall here, marking incident. I can run the route override. Any blocked/regulated customers we should holdback?

SRE-bot: Incident INC-203812-12 created by Priya - EU-CT GPU degradation. Runbook: infra/evac-redispatch.md. Links: https://pager.internal/inc/INC-203812-12

Maria: Two customers have tag eu_pii — we should carve them out and preserve affinity to eu for them. Also want to avoid full hard failover; let's do a canary + surgical weight tweak.

Kyle: Command I'll run (dry-run first):
```
rictl gslb update --region eu-central --set-weight 10 --fallback na-west --ttl 20 --note "surgical-redispatch"
```
And route exception for EU PII: 
```
rictl route put --selector tag:eu_pii --region eu-central --force
```

Jon: Add canary header X-RI-Canary:1 to 5% first. Monitor kvcache hit-rate, model hot-shard errors, and prefix-caching stalls. Abort if kvcache miss-rate >50% or model errors spike.

Lee: Also recommend reducing per-pool concurrency on eu to 60% temporarily to stop queue pileup while we rebalance.

Priya: Running override now, will post outputs here.

DeployBot: Route update job queued: job-id=2038123456-1 by Kyle.

Maria: :thumbsup: Keep TTL at 20, check telemetry at +2m and +6m. If p95 falls <500ms and no customer errors, we can keep for the 10m window and then gradually restore.

Priya: Override complete. Logs: route update success, weights: eu=10%, na-west=90%. Canary header at 5% enabled. Monitoring: https://dashboards.internal/r/INC-203812-12 - kvcache warmup spike seen at +90s but recovered by +4m.

Kyle: Holdback for eu_pii confirmed: sessions still hitting eu nodes and not redirected.

Jon: p95 dropped to ~480ms after ~4m. kvcache stabilized; no model hot-shard errors. Continuing watch.

Maria: Good progress. Keep thread open for 30m then rollback TTL to normal and restore original weights if stable. Thanks all. :eyes:
